mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TRADINGREVIEWS WHERE REVIEWIDX = #{reviewIdx} AND USERIDX = #{userIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADINGREVIEWS SET ISHIDDEN = 1 WHERE REVIEWIDX = #{reviewIdx} AND USERIDX = #{userIdx}
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REVIEWIDX, R.SALEREVIEWTYPE, R.CONTENT, R.REVIEWTAGS, TO_CHAR(R.CREATEDDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdDate, R.CREATEDDATE AS rawCreatedDate, R.SCORE, R.USERIDX, R.PRODUCTIDX, U.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, U.PROFILE_PHOTO AS profilePhoto, U.ADDR AS writerAddr, P.TITLE AS productTitle FROM TRADINGREVIEWS R LEFT JOIN USERS U ON R.USERIDX = U.USERIDX LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCTIDX = P.PRODUCTIDX
R.ISHIDDEN = 0
AND R.SALEREVIEWTYPE = 'BUYER'
AND R.SALEREVIEWTYPE = 'SELLER'
AND R.USERIDX = #{userIdx}
ORDER BY R.REVIEWIDX DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADINGREVIEWS WHERE ISHIDDEN = 0

SELECT
t.SELLERIDX as TARGET_USERIDX, u.NICKNAME as TARGET_NICKNAME
t.BUYERIDX as TARGET_USERIDX, u.NICKNAME as TARGET_NICKNAME
FROM TRADETRANSACTION t JOIN USERS u ON u.USERIDX =
t.SELLERIDX t.BUYERIDX
WHERE t.PRODUCTIDX = #{productIdx}
